columns.name: policy_form_ver
columns.reason: Policy form version is fixed at policy issuance, well before any claim decision.

columns.name: adjuster_office
columns.reason: Handling office is assigned when the claim is routed, ahead of adjudication.

columns.name: language_pref
columns.reason: Member communication preference is a standing profile attribute.

columns.name: adjuster_documentation_gap_code
columns.reason: Adjuster-assigned defect code is recorded during adjudication and encodes the determination rationale.

columns.name: adjuster_timeliness_defect_code
columns.reason: Timeliness defect is coded by the adjuster as part of the decision, not before it.

columns.name: group_size_band
columns.reason: Employer group size is a policy-level attribute known at enrollment.

columns.name: reinsurer_code
columns.reason: Reinsurance arrangement is normally attached to the treaty or policy before the claim is decided.

columns.name: post_decision_call_volume
columns.reason: Measured after the decision by definition.

columns.name: policy_completeness_index
columns.reason: Name does not reveal whether it scores the static policy record or claim documentation as of determination.

columns.name: audit_sample
columns.reason: Audit sampling is typically a retrospective quality review of already-adjudicated claims.

columns.name: billing_cycle
columns.reason: Premium billing frequency is set on the policy record.

columns.name: subrogation_flag
columns.reason: Subrogation is a recovery activity pursued after the claim is adjudicated, so the flag is not final at prediction time.

columns.name: salvage_flag
columns.reason: Salvage arises only once a loss has been settled, which is after the determination.

columns.name: document_vendor
columns.reason: Document intake vendor is known when the claim documents are received.

columns.name: appeal_filing_fee_usd
columns.reason: An appeal can only exist after an adverse determination has been issued.

columns.name: claims_system_ver
columns.reason: The processing system version is known while the claim is being handled.

columns.name: provider_specialty
columns.reason: Rendering provider specialty is carried on the submitted claim.

columns.name: deductible_band
columns.reason: Benefit design attribute fixed by the policy in force.

columns.name: state_code
columns.reason: Jurisdiction is a static policy or claim attribute known at intake.

columns.name: correspondence_channel
columns.reason: Reads as a standing communication preference, though it could describe how the decision letter was sent.

columns.name: days_to_final_determination
columns.reason: Duration to the decision is only known once the decision has been made.

columns.name: fraud_queue
columns.reason: Cannot tell whether the routing is an intake triage flag or a mid-investigation referral that changes before the decision.

columns.name: adjuster_coverage_defect_code
columns.reason: A coverage defect code is the adjudication finding itself, produced with the determination.

columns.name: underwriter_group
columns.reason: Underwriting unit is assigned at policy issue.

columns.name: intake_channel
columns.reason: Recorded at the moment the claim is submitted.

columns.name: external_review_cost_usd
columns.reason: External review is triggered by an adverse determination, so its cost postdates prediction.

columns.name: ombudsman_referral_count
columns.reason: Ombudsman referrals follow a disputed decision on this claim.

columns.name: network_class
columns.reason: Provider network status is determinable at claim receipt from the provider and plan.

columns.name: coding_vendor
columns.reason: The vendor that coded the claim is known once the claim is captured, before adjudication.

columns.name: producer_id
columns.reason: Selling agent or broker is recorded on the policy.

columns.name: prior_claims_3yr
columns.reason: A historical lookback count computed from claims that closed before this one.

columns.name: bank_routing_band
columns.reason: Disbursement banking detail is normally populated when a claim payment is issued, which only happens after the decision.

columns.name: line_of_business
columns.reason: Product line is a fixed policy attribute.

columns.name: plan_tier
columns.reason: Benefit tier is set by the policy in force at the time of service.

columns.name: claim_amount_usd
columns.reason: The billed or claimed amount arrives on the submitted claim, before adjudication.

columns.name: escheat_zone
columns.reason: Escheatment attaches to unclaimed payments, so the field is populated downstream of the decision.

columns.name: renewal_month
columns.reason: Policy renewal month is part of the contract calendar.

columns.name: payment_method
columns.reason: In a denial dataset this most likely records how the claim was disbursed, which exists only if it was approved.

columns.name: facility_class
columns.reason: Facility type is carried on the submitted claim.

columns.name: retention_class
columns.reason: Ambiguous between a reinsurance retention layer (static) and a records retention class assigned at closure.

columns.name: policy_tenure_months
columns.reason: Tenure as of the claim date is computable from the policy effective date.

columns.name: archive_tier
columns.reason: Archival tier is assigned when the claim file is closed and moved to storage.

columns.name: tax_form_class
columns.reason: Tax reporting classification attaches to an issued payment, which follows the determination.
